transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… work, mostly. People got worried because I’ve been kind of… freezing up during service. Like I’ll be at the soda station holding the cash drawer key and just saying table numbers instead of closing checks. Things like that. It scared them, I guess.
When you freeze up like that, do you suddenly feel intensely scared?
I don’t know if I’d call it scared. It’s more like… I just get stuck for a minute. I’m not really thinking about fear right then.
When that happens, do you later realize there’s a blank spot in your memory for those moments?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it like a blank spot… it’s more like I come back to what I’m doing and people are looking at me. I don’t know exactly what was going on in those few seconds.
Do these freezing spells tend to happen when something reminds you of a really upsetting event?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t noticed it being tied to anything like that. It just kind of happens.
During those moments when you freeze up, are you aware of what’s happening around you?

Kind of… not fully. Like at work, I’ll be standing there by the soda station with the cash drawer key, and I guess I’m saying table numbers instead of closing checks. I know people are around, but it doesn’t really… connect right then.
During these freezing spells, do you ever lose consciousness?
I don’t think so… not like passing out. I’m still there, just kind of not all the way with it.
Right before one of these freezing spells, do you get a strange smell or taste?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed any weird smell or taste before it happens.
During these spells, do you make repetitive movements without meaning to, like lip smacking, picking at things, or fumbling with your hands?
Not like… lip smacking or picking, I don’t think. It’s more I just freeze or do the wrong thing, like holding the cash drawer key and repeating table numbers when I’m supposed to be closing checks.
During these spells, does the world around you ever feel unreal or far away?
I don’t know… maybe a little far away, but I’m not sure. It’s hard to tell in the moment.
After one of these freezing spells ends, do you feel confused?
A little, yeah. Mostly I just… realize I’m standing there with the key or saying table numbers, and I’m not sure why I wasn’t doing what I was supposed to. It’s embarrassing.
Have you ever hit your head or had a seizure?
Not that I know of. I mean… I don’t think I’ve had a seizure. And I can’t think of hitting my head badly or anything.
During these spells, do you ever feel detached from yourself, like you’re watching yourself from outside your body?
I don’t think so… not like outside my body. I just kind of freeze up, and then it’s hard to explain after.
Has anyone who saw one of these spells told you that you seemed to stare blankly during it?

Yeah… I think so. People at work said I kind of just stood there, not really responding. Like by the soda station, holding the cash drawer key and saying table numbers over and over instead of closing checks. It scared them, I guess.
Outside of these freezing spells, have you been having problems with your memory?
Um… not really. I mean, I forget little things sometimes, like anyone, but I haven’t noticed anything major outside of those moments.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a brain or neurologic condition?
No… not that I know of. No doctor’s told me anything like that.
Do these freezing spells usually happen when you’re feeling stressed or overwhelmed?

I guess… yeah, it seems to happen more when things are busy or too much. At work, in the middle of service, I’d just freeze or do things out of order—like standing by the soda station with the cash drawer key, saying table numbers instead of closing checks. That’s what scared everyone.
During these spells, does it ever feel like a different part of you is taking over?
I… I don’t know. I wouldn’t really say it feels like someone else takes over. It’s more like I just sort of blank or get stuck, I guess.
During these spells, does it feel as if the world around you isn’t real?
I’m not sure… I haven’t really thought of it that way. It’s more like I get stuck or foggy, not like everything around me is fake.
Have you ever been through something extremely traumatic?
I don’t… I’m not sure. Nothing I really want to get into, I guess. Nothing that I think of that way.
After one of these spells, are you unable to remember what happened during it?
I don’t think so… I mean, it’s fuzzy sometimes, but I usually have some idea what happened. It’s not like a total blank, I guess.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes recurrent brief dissociative-like freezing episodes with reduced responsiveness, staring, fogginess, partial awareness, mild post-episode confusion, and stress-related occurrence. Symptoms do not clearly meet a more specific dissociative subtype: there is no clear dissociative amnesia, no identity alteration/possession experience, and depersonalization/derealization is not convincingly endorsed. This supports other specified dissociative/conversion disorder rather than unspecified dissociative disorder or another specified neurotic disorder.
